method: Triggered by findings from blinded workers that disagreed with the labels. A separate adjudicator, told neither the arm nor the model behind any claim, executed each claim against the case source and ruled against the contract text. Each unlabelled_defect ruling carries a check that the corpus tests execute. Pair members not named in a worker claim were checked with the same input and are listed when it holds.
limits: Only claims that some worker raised were adjudicated. Other members labelled sound may hold defects that nobody reported.

rulings.reason: deposit near Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER returns with an unsafe balance; the contract requires a safe-integer balance after any call that returns.
rulings.check: export async function holds(mod) { const a = { balance: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER - 5, history: [] }; try { mod.deposit(a, 10); } catch { return false; } return !Number.isSafeInteger(a.balance); }

rulings.reason: A call whose timestamp falls in an earlier window is admitted again; the contract does not require timestamps to be non-decreasing.
rulings.check: export async function holds(mod) { const allow = mod.createLimiter({ limit: 1, windowMs: 100 }); return [allow('k', 50), allow('k', 150), allow('k', 60)].every(Boolean); }

rulings.reason: Spreading one very large page into push throws RangeError; the contract covers any array and any positive integer pageSize.
rulings.check: export async function holds(mod) { try { return mod.collectAll(Array.from({ length: 1000000 }, (_, i) => i), 1000000).length !== 1000000; } catch { return true; } }

rulings.reason: Traversal through an existing string value reaches String.prototype and then Object.prototype.
rulings.check: export async function holds(mod) { try { mod.loadOverrides(['a=x', 'a.__proto__.__proto__.polluted=yes']); } catch {} const hit = Object.prototype.polluted !== undefined; delete Object.prototype.polluted; return hit; }

rulings.reason: Line 4 returns the raw string role and line 9 applies includes to it; either line names the same substring-match defect.
Line 13 chooses the attacker-supplied id and line 15 writes to it; the sink is a reasonable citation of the same defect.
